node22.problem: Absolute-only container name predicate missed Node22 cwd-relative names; passing Node20 alone was not supported-runtime acceptance.

findings.resolution: Capture runner cwd and require path.resolve(runnerCwd, data.name) to equal the absolute data.file. Preserve exact nesting/line/column shape and enqueue/dequeue/complete sequence; do not substitute case sums or silently label Node22 unsupported.
findings.verification: All original acceptance assertions retained. Added relative-container and mismatched-name regression; independently rerun 10/10 on both supported versions.

reviewedInvariants: Reporter consumes the event stream without selecting/filtering executable tests or overriding process.exitCode.
Normal TAP can run alongside telemetry; an actual failing assertion and nonzero file subprocess exit retain ordinary failed runner status.
Durations exactly equal native file-container complete-event duration_ms, including startup/import cost; nested/concurrent case times and log-arrival gaps are not summed.

Recognized containers require one ordered enqueue/dequeue/complete sequence and positive finite duration with boolean pass state. Duplicate, incomplete, unordered and malformed containers are rejected.

Explicit source revision and selected inventory are required for usable output; duplicate/unsafe inventory, missing/extra file durations, failed files and skipped/todo cases invalidate the final summary.
Absent container support fails closed and supplies no replacement case-sum measurement.
Node20 absolute and Node22 cwd-relative names must bind to the same absolute data.file; source-root override is not incorrectly used as the dispatch cwd.
outcome: No remaining concrete blocker found in the two exact reviewed reporter files. Raw telemetry support verified locally on Node 20.19.5 and Node 22.22.2.

shipping.reason: New scripts are outside the explicit shipped build includes. A future source archive would contain committed tooling; current immutable release assets are unchanged.

limits: This is raw event telemetry, not a qualified timing-weight manifest or hosted performance result.

Future consumer must require a complete usable final summary, rebind source/inventory/runtime/runner and reporter identities, and preserve test invocation/concurrency context; caller-provided metadata is not independently authenticated by this reporter.
No production workflow opt-in, converter, full-suite qualification, hosted speed measurement or publication acceptance is certified.
Review covers only the listed file hashes; unrelated reporter measurement documentation, runner changes and later edits require their own evidence.
Initial Node22 failure count is retained as coordinator-reported evidence; final dual-runtime reruns were independently executed.
Only this review receipt was authored; no source edits, commits, pushes, workflow triggers or release actions were performed.
